body.name: Projector, row-sum, and contribution recovery map
body.construction:
For each cohort \(d\), calculate \(g^d\), \(\rho_j^d\), \(P_j^d\), \(B_a^d=[P_1^dm_a^d,P_2^dm_a^d]\), \(F_y^d=(B_a^d)^{-1}A_{ay}^d\), \(q_{ay}^d=F_y^d\mathbf 1_3\), \(C_y^d=\operatorname{diag}(q_{ay}^d)^{-1}F_y^d\), \(W^d=A_{ba}^d(C_a^d)^\top\{C_a^d(C_a^d)^\top\}^{-1}\), \(c^d=(W^d)^{-1}m_b^d\), and \(B_b^d=W^d\operatorname{diag}(c^d)\).  Fill \(\widehat Q_j^d\) from \(q_{ay}^d\), \((B_b^d)^{-1}A_{by}^d\mathbf 1_3\), stochastic exit residuals, and the absorbing row; fill \(\widehat R_j^d\) from the rows of \(C_y^d\) and the absorbing row.  Set
\[
 \widehat s_j^d=(\mathbf 1_2^\top B_a^d[:,j],\mathbf 1_2^\top B_b^d[:,j],0),
 \qquad \widehat\alpha_j^d=\widehat s_j^d\mathbf 1_3,
\]
\[
 \widehat p_{2,j}^d=(\widehat\alpha_j^d)^{-1}\widehat s_j^d\widehat Q_j^d,
 \qquad
 \widehat\nu_j=\widehat s_j^1\widehat Q_j^1(\widehat R_j^1-\widehat R_j^0),
 \qquad
 \widehat\eta_j=\widehat\nu_j/\widehat\alpha_j^1.
\]
Order both cohorts by \(\rho_1^d>\rho_2^d\), and define
\[
 \Phi(p)=(\widehat\nu_1^\top,\widehat\nu_2^\top,
          (\widehat\nu_1+\widehat\nu_2)^\top)^\top.
\]
For empirical vectors off the compatible model, use \(\widehat Q_j^1\) in the displayed contribution, so the extension is single valued.
